IPCC 2006 Source/Sink Category: 3.C.4 - Direct N2O Emissions from managed soils
Description: Nitrification inhibitor effect in Paddy Rice
Technologies / Practices: 111 datasets from 39 studies for which experiments were conducted between 1996 and 2014 covering four major land uses (grassland, cropland, paddy and upland). For each dataset, the information collated included: mean cumulative N?O emissions from control, treatment with fertilizers and treatment with the same fertilizers plus inhibitor; inhibitor effect (as a percentage reduction of the emission), emission factor for each NI treatment (EF), NI type, NI application rate, fertilizer type, total N application rate, land use, number of replicates, soil texture, air or soil temperature (mean, temperature maxima or minima), rainfall and period of measurements.
Parameters / Conditions: A meta-analysis was carried out using GenStat (v.16; VSN International) to estimate NI effect according to soil, fertiliser and inhibitor type and land use.
Abatement / Control Technologies: Reduction of nitrous oxide emissions due to application of dicyandiamide
Source of data: Peer-reviewed journal
